# Miracle Websoft

> Shopify development agency based in Punjab, India, working remotely with merchants in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and Europe. Store builds, Shopify Plus, custom apps and API integrations, speed and conversion work, migrations to Shopify, and ongoing support or a dedicated Shopify developer.

## Company facts

- Founder: Karam Singh Mehra, Shopify developer (profile: https://miraclewebsoft.com/bio/owner)
- Location: Rajpura, Punjab, India (near Chandigarh). In-house team of 15. Remote delivery only; no overseas offices.
- Upwork: founder profile is Top Rated Plus with $600K+ total earnings and 780+ jobs (checked 27 November 2026). Agency: https://www.upwork.com/agencies/shopifyexpertsdevelopers/
- Client reviews, each with its own page: https://miraclewebsoft.com/reviews
- Project records from Upwork work: https://miraclewebsoft.com/work
- Listings: Shopify Partner Directory https://www.shopify.com/partners/directory/partner/miracle-websoft1 · Clutch https://clutch.co/profile/miracle-websoft · Trustpilot https://www.trustpilot.com/review/miraclewebsoft.com · DesignRush https://www.designrush.com/agency/profile/miracle-websoft
- Pricing: https://miraclewebsoft.com/pricing (fixed-price offers; larger work is quoted)
